## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) and VXX CORRECTION (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%) signal mixed risk sentiment while credit stress rising via HYG (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) / LQD (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%) confirms caution.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) and LQD (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%) in CORRECTION signal tighter funding tone. Volatility mixed: VIX up (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +6.40%) ABOVE TREND while VXX shows a CORRECTION profile (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Equivocal: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +3.00%) alongside SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) keeps stocks vs bonds neutral and duration favored but not decisively risk-on.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%). Tech mixed: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) while Financials RECOVERY (XLF: 1W: +0.31% | 1M: -4.58%) — style tilt toward cyclicals/energy versus growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) and QQQ RECOVERY (1W: +1.11% | 1M: -3.39%). EM mixed: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.75%) while China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation showing pockets of life: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.17%) and IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +7.24% | 1M: -17.66%) indicate risk-tolerant flows but with uneven duration.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy-led reflation: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) and USO (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +10.17%) driving commodity strength; copper CPER RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -5.99%) remains tentative. Gold holding as hedge: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +1.81% | 1M: -1.19%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy broadly strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) with Brent BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%); natural gas volatile with UNG RECOVERY (1W: +2.21% | 1M: -20.32%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W and 1M positive) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W and 1M positive) show genuine cyclical leadership. MAJOR divergence present: multiple core ETFs (SPY, QQQ, XLK, VXX) show 1W vs 1M mismatch, suppressing a strong regime call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/energy exposure via XLE and industrials XLI while reducing exposure to stretched tech momentum (XLK, QQQ); bonds via TLT remain a neutral ballast given mixed signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%). BEARISH: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) and XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -2.61%) — watch tech/consumer discretionary.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +10.17%). BEARISH: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -5.99%) — copper weakness would signal cyclical risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX ~29 (elevated complacency risk); HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7238 (credit stress monitor); Tech vs Financials 2.7201 (watch for style rotation pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but mixed volatility and rising credit stress produce offsetting signals. Energy and cyclicals showing strength while tech/volatility divergences and credit metrics are the key risks to monitor.
